biggest_catch: Zero guaranteed earnings: you must build your own audience first, income is entirely viewer-driven (subs, Bits, ads), Twitch takes its cut, payouts release only after a threshold, and the catalog's old eligibility (50 followers / 500 minutes / 7 days) was superseded in 2026 by a lower bar — 25 followers, 4 hours (240 minutes), 4 broadcast days, 3 average viewers over 30 days.
catches: No guaranteed income — earnings come only from viewers who subscribe, cheer Bits, or watch ads; a tiny channel earns $0.
You must build the audience yourself: no followers, no viewers, no earnings.
Twitch takes a cut of subscription revenue (roughly 50/50) and applies a payout threshold before any money is released.
Variable income: monthly earnings swing with viewership, subs, and ad rates — this is not a wage.
The Affiliate Agreement includes live-content exclusivity terms (your Twitch live content cannot be simulcast elsewhere in the same window per contract section 2.2) — read it before signing.
Two-factor authentication is required to complete Affiliate onboarding; 18+ (or 13–17 with parental/guardian consent).

c1.evidence: Twitch is a real operating platform (Amazon-owned); the Affiliate Program is its official monetization tier documented in Twitch's own help article.

c2.evidence: Official help article 'Joining the Affiliate Program' documents the invitation-based Affiliate onboarding; the route's reward description matches the mechanism (subscription revenue share, Bits, ad revenue).

c3.evidence: No upfront fee to join the Affiliate Program; costs are Twitch's revenue share, not an entry fee.

c4.evidence: No official fixed payout figure exists — Affiliate earnings are viewer-driven (subs/Bits/ads) and vary, so payout_quote is null; mechanism-only verify.

eligibility: Current (2026) bar within a rolling 30-day period: 25 followers; 4 hours (240 minutes) broadcast; broadcast on 4 different days; average of 3 concurrent viewers. Twitch issues the invitation via dashboard/email/notification once met; two-factor authentication required; 18+ (13–17 with parental consent).
notes: Eligibility corrected from the catalog's obsolete 50 followers / 500 minutes / 7 days: Twitch lowered the Affiliate threshold in 2026 ('Monetization for All'); current guides citing the official help article confirm 25 followers, 240 minutes, 4 days, 3 average viewers. No official payout figure is published for Affiliate earnings (subs/Bits/ad rates vary), so payout_quote is null — mechanism-only verify.

steps: Create a Twitch account and set up your channel; enable two-factor authentication early — it is required for Affiliate onboarding.
Broadcast live streams regularly; track progress in Creator Dashboard → Analytics → Achievements ('Path to Affiliate').
Within a rolling 30-day period, reach: 25 followers, 240 minutes broadcast, 4 different broadcast days, and an average of 3 concurrent viewers.
Accept the invitation (dashboard, email, or notification) and complete onboarding: provide registration info, sign the Twitch Affiliate Agreement, complete the tax interviews, and set payout details.
Enable monetization features (subscriptions, Bits, ads) on your channel; payouts release per Twitch's payout threshold.
timing: Payouts per Twitch's payout terms after the payout threshold is reached; earnings are only what your viewers actually spend.
